title: EvoTS-Agent: A Self-Evolving LLM Agent for Financial Time Series Change Point Detection

claim.summary: EvoTS-Agent preserves executable experiment trajectories and changes search operators when validation improvements stagnate, applied to financial change-point detection.

modules.name: Validation-controlled trajectory evolution
modules.scope_reason: Revision, strategy switching, recombination and incumbent preservation depend on an external validation score, not change-point-specific mathematics.

modules.name: Change-sensitive EDA and detector selection
modules.scope_reason: Local mean/variance discrepancies and detector-bank selection are designed for change-point detection.
